provider.description: Active provider bundle name (deepseek | openai | anthropic).

model.description: Model id the run was started with.

mode.description: Physical harness policy for this run.

face.description: Entry assembly serving the run (web | tui | code | headless). Journals written before faces existed mean web.

policy_profile.description: Immutable governance profile selected for this run.

policy_hash.description: Digest of the policy definition used by the run.

sandbox_mode.description: Immutable sandbox mode selected for this run.

approval_policy.description: Immutable approval policy selected for this run.

prompt_schema.description: Immutable prompt snapshot schema admitted for this run.

prompt_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the admitted prompt snapshot payload.
